description: Profile manifest for the ccr router. Every installed plugin and standalone skill is either assigned to exactly one domain profile or listed as unassigned (installed, hidden everywhere). Plugins may appear in more than one profile only when the domain genuinely needs them.

router.description: User-facing router: classify intent, dispatch background Claude Code sessions with the right profile and model, keep each session's must-retain context current, and report progress.

quick.description: Easy tasks: a quick question, a one-file small edit, a lookup, or running a command.

dev.description: General software work: features, refactors, debugging, multi-file changes, tests, and planning.

rust.description: Rust implementation: cargo, clippy, unsafe, concurrency, rust-analyzer. Security review goes to review.

review.description: Review, security audit, and verification: code review, PR review, Rust security review, vulnerability analysis, false-positive checks.

librarian.description: Librarian: read-only remote-code and docs research across GitHub, dependencies, and the web; writing/diagrams when asked.

go.description: Go implementation: packages, concurrency, errors, gopls, gofmt/vet/test.

python.description: Python implementation: uv, ruff, ty/pyright, pytest, Pydantic; no pip shims.

oracle.description: Oracle: read-only senior analysis, architecture, planning, debugging hypotheses, and second opinions.

unassignedPlugins.claude-session-driver@superpowers-market: The router uses native background sessions; tmux workers are redundant and bypass the profile boundary.
unassignedPlugins.double-shot-latte@superpowers-marketplac: Its Stop hook runs a model call on every stop; the router already decides when to continue.
unassignedPlugins.modern-web-guidance@claude-plugins-offic: Currently disabled upstream; enable it explicitly in a profile if needed.
unassignedPlugins.redis-development@claude-plugins-officia: Currently disabled; enable it explicitly in a profile if needed.
unassignedPlugins.remember@claude-plugins-official: Adds memory hooks to every session; the router keeps an explicit per-session ledger instead.
unassignedPlugins.code-simplifier@claude-plugins-official: Replaced by the /simplify command: a top model already knows how to simplify code; the command keeps the scope and verification rules.
unassignedPlugins.commit-commands@claude-plugins-official: Replaced by /commit and /pr: git workflow is prompt work, not a plugin capability.
unassignedPlugins.feature-dev@claude-plugins-official: Replaced by /feature: a top model can explore, plan, implement and test without a multi-agent plugin.
unassignedPlugins.claude-md-management@claude-plugins-offi: Replaced by /claude-md: auditing CLAUDE.md is a focused prompt, not an always-on plugin.
unassignedPlugins.claude-code-setup@claude-plugins-officia: Replaced by /setup-audit: the audit checklist is small enough to keep as a command.
unassignedPlugins.hookify@claude-plugins-official: Replaced by /hook: hook creation is a short recipe; the command avoids another always-on skill.
unassignedPlugins.skill-creator@claude-plugins-official: Replaced by /skill: skill authoring is a focused prompt; the plugin was only used occasionally.
unassignedPlugins.code-review@claude-plugins-official: Replaced by /review: a top model performs the review; the review profile keeps the security-specific plugins.
unassignedPlugins.pr-review-toolkit@claude-plugins-officia: Replaced by /review-pr: the specialized agent fan-out is not needed for routine PR review.
unassignedPlugins.security-guidance@claude-plugins-officia: Replaced by /security-check and the review profile: the plugin injected PostToolUse/Stop hooks into every session.
unassignedPlugins.modern-python@trailofbits: Replaced by /python plus the dev profile prompt: the PATH shims and hooks are intrusive and the conventions are model knowledge.
unassignedPlugins.modern-go-guidelines@goland-claude-marke: Replaced by /go: Go conventions are model knowledge and the repo already has gopls.
unassignedPlugins.pydantic@pydantic-skills: Replaced by /pydantic: the common API patterns fit in a command; the version-specific docs stay in the repo.
unassignedPlugins.superpowers@claude-plugins-official: Replaced by /tdd, /debug and /brainstorm: the core workflows are model knowledge; the large skill library was always on.
unassignedPlugins.ralph-loop@claude-plugins-official: The router owns continuation and progress loops; the plugin adds a Stop hook to every dev session.
